trial_court: XVIII Addl.City Civil Judge at [CCH.NO.10], Bangalore City. O.S.No.3363/2008

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Kum.Roshini J.Reddy, daughter of Late G.Jayaram Reddy, minor reptd by her mother / Natural Guardian Smt.M.Shameem Banu
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt.J.Pavithra Reddy, w/o Late G.Jayaram Reddy, and others (1-7)

facts_of_case: The plaintiff is the daughter of Smt.M.Shameem Banu, seeking partition and separate possession of half share in the suit schedule property.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party claiming a relationship to prove it.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff was a minor when the suit was instituted. The suit initially was represented by her mother Smt.M.Shameem Banu as a natural guardian and after attaining majority she continued the proceedings in her individual capacity.

legal_principles.principle: The testimony of a witness can withstand the test of cross-examination if it is consistent and credible.
legal_principles.held: PW2 withstood the test of cross examination and has specifically stated that her marriage with late G.Jayaramareddy was took place on 18.1.1991 and the plaintiff was born to her through Late G.Jayaramareddy out of the wedlock on 28.8.1993.

outcome.final_order: Partition and separate possession of half share in the suit schedule property by metes and bounds, and for permanent injunction restraining the defendants from alienating the suit schedule property.

keywords: B A N G A L O R E
